history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Change To Empty Return details.
features: Sometimes detention charges are applicable to containers returned by the customer which were already released to them; the user can use "Change To Empty Return" to convert the container to Empty Return status and calculate these charges.
PR status should be "Supplied" or "Full Return".
PR status should not be "Prepared" or "Empty Return".
If the Container is linked to a B/L, the process will return an error, so the user should delink the container from the B/L.

events.description: Opens the Change to Empty Return (PR Number) popup asking "Do you want to update the container as empty return?"
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Change to Empty Return from the single function menu

events.description: Changes the PR Status to Empty Return. Message: "Empty return status changed successfully"
Closes the popup without changing the PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks Cancel on the popup
